_about: Countries Walo runs in. Everything a country changes lives here, so the code contains no country: which coordinates are accepted, the money on Sell, the rain-season search windows, the zone names, the map, the labels on sources. Adding a country is a data change plus a check by someone who farms there. A country only appears in the app when status is "live"; anything half-sourced stays "draft" and is never selectable.

bbox._note: Walo deliberately accepts a margin around the country so 'use my location' near a border still works; the nearest town still has to be in places.json.

major_search.note: No single standard start date for Ghana; Sivakumar (1988) searched from 1 May in the Sahel. Walo starts at 1 March so the forest and transition zones are not missed.

minor_search.note: Second (minor) season searched only in the bimodal zones (FAO zone text: forest, transition, coastal savanna).

zones._source: FAO Ghana agro-ecological zones (crop calendar region text)

KE.name: Kenya
KE._status_note: Draft: the planting windows come from the FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar and the Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar in the Kenya Food Security Data Book, not from someone who farms there. A country only becomes selectable when checked_by_local is true.

bbox._note: The same margin around the country as Ghana, so 'use my location' near a border still works; the nearest town still has to be in places.json.

major_search.note: The long rains (masika) fall March-May, so Walo searches from 1 March. FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar 2024.

minor_search.note: The short rains (vuli) fall October-December and are the main season on the coast and in eastern Kenya. The highlands (KH) are treated as one long season, so no second search is made there.

zones._source: Kenya rainfall regimes from the FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar (long rains March-May, short rains October-December) and the Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar in the Kenya Food Security Data Book 2025

KE.name: Eastern and coast, short rains main

sources.crop_calendar: FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar 2024 and Kenya Food Security Data Book 2025 (Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar)
sources.prices: WFP market prices via HDX HAPI
